name: Hop
source:
A baby dragon snuggling up to Natane.
The dragon itself is a rare existence, and claws, scales, and fangs are all expensive materials.
Among them, the Crystal of Tears is so precious that one grain can buy a town, and it is even said to be a phantom.

“…………Gaut?”
